lines: d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. DeAndre Chen is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d40: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d40: 🕯️ DeAndre Chen is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d40: What DeAndre kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d40: "DeAndre's gone." Saul looks at you for a long moment. "You're not DeAndre." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
